# Ezekiel 36 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** "Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel. Say: Mountains of Israel, listen to the LORD's message!

**2** This is what the Sovereign LORD says: The enemy has gloated over you, saying, 'Good! Those ancient heights now belong to us!'

**3** So prophesy and say: This is what the Sovereign LORD says — They devastated you from every direction, making you the property of surrounding nations, the subject of everyone's gossip and slander.

**4** So listen, mountains of Israel, to the message of the Sovereign LORD. He speaks to the mountains and hills, the ravines and valleys, the ruined wastelands and deserted towns that have been looted and mocked by surrounding nations.

**5** The Sovereign LORD says: In the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the surrounding nations and against Edom, who seized my land for themselves with malicious glee and utter contempt, driving out its people to plunder the land.

**6** Therefore, prophesy about the land of Israel. Say to the mountains and hills, the ravines and valleys: The Sovereign LORD says — I speak in jealous anger because you have suffered the mockery of the nations.

**7** So the Sovereign LORD says: I swear with my hand raised that the surrounding nations will suffer their own shame.

**8** But you, mountains of Israel, will produce heavy crops of fruit for my people Israel, because they will be coming home soon!

**9** I am on your side! I will come to help you, and your land will be plowed and planted again.

**10** I will greatly increase the population of Israel, and the ruined cities will be rebuilt and filled with people.

**11** I will increase not only the people but also your animals. Everything will be fruitful and productive. I will make the land even more prosperous than it was in the past. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

**12** I will cause my people Israel to walk across your land. You will be their inheritance, and you will never again rob them of their children.

**13** This is what the Sovereign LORD says: People say your land devours its inhabitants and robs its nation of children.

**14** But you will never again devour people or rob your nation of children, says the Sovereign LORD.

**15** I will not let the nations insult you anymore, and you will no longer be mocked by other peoples or cause your nation to fall, says the Sovereign LORD.

**16** Then another message came to me from the LORD:

**17** Son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own land, they defiled it by the way they lived. To me their conduct was as unclean as a woman's menstrual cloth.

**18** So I poured out my fury on them because of the murders they committed and the idols that contaminated the land.

**19** I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through many lands. I judged them according to the way they had lived.

**20** But wherever they went among the nations, they brought disgrace on my holy name. For the nations said, 'These are the people of the LORD, and yet they had to leave his land!'

**21** So I was deeply concerned about my holy reputation, which the people of Israel had ruined among the nations.

**22** Therefore, give the people of Israel this message from the Sovereign LORD: I am bringing you back — but not because you deserve it. I am doing it to protect my holy name, which you have disgraced among the nations.

**23** I will demonstrate the holiness of my great name, which you have profaned among the nations. And when I reveal my holiness through you before their watching eyes, then the nations will know that I am the LORD, says the Sovereign LORD.

**24** I will gather you from among the nations and bring you home to your own land.

**25** I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will wash away all your filth and cleanse you from your idol worship.

**26** And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in you. I will take out your stubborn, stony heart and give you a tender, responsive heart instead.

**27** And I will put my Spirit in you so that you will follow my decrees and be careful to obey my regulations.

**28** You will live in the land I gave your ancestors. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

**29** I will free you from all your sins. I will call for grain and make it plentiful and will not bring famine on you.

**30** I will multiply the fruit on your trees and the crops in your fields, and you will never again be shamed by famine among the nations.

**31** Then you will remember your past sins and despise yourselves for all the evil things you did.

**32** But understand this — I'm not doing this for your benefit, says the Sovereign LORD. Let that be perfectly clear. Be ashamed of yourselves for everything you have done, people of Israel!

**33** This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When I cleanse you from your sins, I will repopulate your cities, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

**34** The formerly desolate land will be farmed again, no longer lying empty for everyone to see.

**35** People will say, 'This land that was ruined has become like the Garden of Eden! The cities that were in ruins, deserted, and destroyed, are now fortified and full of people!'

**36** Then the surrounding nations that survive will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt the ruins and replanted the wasteland. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do what I say.

**37** This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will also do this for the people of Israel, if they ask me. I will multiply their population as if they were a flock of sheep.

**38** Like the vast flocks of sheep brought to Jerusalem for the festivals, the ruined cities will be filled with people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **36:22**: God is bracingly honest here: I'm not doing this because you deserve it. Restoration is a gift, not a reward. This is grace before the word 'grace' was invented.

- **36:26-27**: This is one of the most revolutionary promises in the Bible. God doesn't just want better behavior — He's going to change the human heart itself. External rules aren't enough; we need internal transformation. This is what the New Testament calls being 'born again.'

- **36:35**: Imagine your neighbors saying, 'This place used to be a wasteland, and now it looks like the Garden of Eden!' God's restoration is so dramatic it makes people stop and stare.

— PNEUMA
